post.summary: Update or soft-delete an ad (sending `"status":2` deletes; underlying UPDATE sets status=2)

parameters.name: kind
parameters.description: PHP Vue index often omits this; default matches 职位分类.

post.summary: PHP `company::add_action`：GET 表单 / POST `submit` 写 member+company。
Force a cache reload from DB. Useful after a manual SQL bulk import.
Update or soft-delete a class (passing `"status":2` in the body means delete)
Reload dictionaries + translation tables immediately and broadcast to the rest of the cluster.
Update or soft-delete a navigation entry (sending `"status":2` deletes it)

Soft-delete (`status=2`). Children are not auto-cascaded — the cache filters
by `status != 2`, so descendants remain visible until the admin explicitly
deletes them.
Force a cluster-wide cache reload from DB (rarely needed; useful after a manual SQL bulk import).
Simulate login as a member (PHP 模拟登录). Returns a member access token; does not switch the admin session.

AdItem.description: Ad management item — all 14 columns of phpyun_ad + formatted timestamps + derived is_active hint for the frontend button.

AdminUserItem.description: User management item — phpyun_member exposed columns (password / salt are not output) + derived usertype/status text + formatted timestamps.

BatchResult.description:
`{ requested, affected }` — bulk-action result envelope. Used by every
admin / employer batch-update / batch-delete endpoint to report how many
items were *requested* (input length) vs. how many were *affected*
(rows the DB actually touched, after auth-scoping and stale filters).

CertItem.description: Admin review queue item — all 10 columns of phpyun_company_cert + CDN URL + formatted timestamps + status name.

status.description: Soft delete: pass `2` to delete the class.

code.description: Stable identifier. ISO 3166-2 form: `CN-BJ` / `US-CA`. Lower levels add a custom suffix: `CN-BJ-CY`.

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (CN/US/...). For non-country rows this should match the country chain.

parent_id.description: `NULL` for country-level rows; otherwise a parent region's id.

CreatedId.description: `{ id }` — used as the create-result envelope across CRUD endpoints.

is_rec.description: 0 = unset, 1 = recommended. Anything else is rejected at validation.

IdBody.description: Body carrying just `{ id }`. Use for any "act on one resource by id" call.

IdsBody.description:
Body carrying `{ ids: Vec<u64> }`. Capped at 200 items, each id 1..=10^8.
Used for batch-delete / batch-update endpoints.

JobSummary.description:
Job list item — aligned with the field set returned by PHPYun
`JobM::getList()`. **Shape is shared across `wap`, `mcenter` and `admin`**
so the front-end card component is identical regardless of the listing
context.

edu_n.description:
Education-level name (PHP `comclass` dict, e.g. "本科") —
filled by `job_summary_from_dict*`; empty for `From<Job>`.

exp_n.description:
Experience-tier name (PHP `comclass` dict, e.g. "5-10 年") —
filled by `job_summary_from_dict*`; empty for `From<Job>`.

is_favorited.description:
Whether the *current* user has favorited this job. Always `false` for
unauthenticated requests / non-favorite contexts.

jobname.description: Three-level job category joined as "Frontend / Web Frontend / React Developer" (PHP `jobname`)

newtime.description:
Posted within the last 2 days (PHP `newtime`); requires `now` ts to
derive — `From<Job>` leaves this `false`.

NavItem.description: Navigation item — all 9 columns of phpyun_navigation + CDN URL + formatted timestamp.

OrderItem.description: Pay order item — all 10 columns of phpyun_pay_order + yuan-unit amount + time formatting.

add.description: PHP `add=1` loads the editor payload instead of saving.

chk_value.description: PHP `$_POST['chk_value']` — array, CSV, or JSON string of nav ids.

StatusFilterBody.description:
`{ status: Option<i32> }` — admin list filter envelope. The 0..=99 bound is
permissive on purpose; handlers further interpret the value (0=pending,
1=approved, ...) via service logic.
PHP pages send `status: ""` or `"0"`; reject those as i32 → HTTP 400.
